description: Adds or replaces files on a website and checks every page against the rules start_website returned. Files not sent stay as they are; delete_website_file removes one, and edit_website_file changes part of one. Never send a photo here as base64: one photo is hundreds of thousands of characters, slow and costly to write; for a photo the person will add, write and give them the photoLink start_website returned: they fill that place themselves and it shows at once. save_website_pictures saves pictures you hold as files or at an https address. If you can run commands with internet access, write the website in a folder and send it all at once, photos included, to siteZip instead of typing every file here. Returns the viewUrl, keepUrl, pages, passed, and problems naming each rule a page breaks, with photoPlaces (each place kept for a photo and whether it is filled) and a photoLink while any is waiting; the person can keep the website once passed is true. A website holds up to 40 files and 12 MB, with pages up to 300 KB and other files up to 2 MB, and can be saved 500 times. A website hosted as written on a plan holds up to 150 files and 32 MB, with other files up to 8 MB, and can be saved any number of times; list_website_files gives the limits of the website at hand.

checkOnPhone.description: true to also check every page on a phone once this is saved, in the same call, as check_website_on_phone does. Send it with your last change before you say the website is ready.

editKey.description: The editKey start_website returned, which proves the website is the caller's. Leave it out for a website in the connected account.

files.description: 1 to 40 files to add or replace, or up to 150 on a website hosted as written on a plan. A file whose path is already saved is overwritten.

content.description: The file's text, or base64 for a small picture you made (an icon) or a font. Not for photos: see photoLink and save_website_pictures.

encoding.description: base64 for pictures and fonts. Text is utf8.

path.description: The file's path from the website's root: lower-case, up to four folders deep, such as index.html, about.html, styles.css or images/shop.jpg. index.html is the home page, and the address /about serves about.html.

websiteId.description: The websiteId start_website returned, or one list_sites shows.

name: save_website_files
title: Save website files
